title: elaphoglossum viscosum var. minus
intro: Elaphoglossum viscosum var. minus, commonly known as a fern species, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Polypodiaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of respiratory issues, such as coughs and bronchitis, due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Elaphoglossum viscosum var. minus include its ability to relieve congestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
